info.description: Submissions from the website's contact, newsletter and enquiry-popup forms. Stored here first; the notification email is a side effect, so an enquiry survives a mail failure.

region.description: Which regional site the enquiry came from — the whole point of the consolidated setup is that this is still distinguishable.

enquiryType.description: Set by forms that need to be told apart within a kind, e.g. the partners page posting "Become a partner".

sourcePath.description: Page the form was submitted from.

ipAddress.description: Kept for abuse investigation. `private` so it never appears in an API response.

viewed.description: Set automatically the first time the entry is opened in the admin.
